title: Auto Play
features:
Auto Play (uses TAS and most stages are recorded already)
and some other features

This script does not work on solara or xeno if on pc use madium https://discord.gg/FaznnTsRD4

Make sure you are on 60fps whilst the script is running

You may have to wait a couple minutes for all the tas files to download the download logs will appear in the console

Credit to tasability for most of the TAS functionality
